propositions: Test workers race on a shared git index when executing separate add and commit calls; alpha's commit can sweep up beta's staged changes, leaving beta with nothing to commit.
When git commit finds nothing staged, it returns rc=1 with empty stderr and 'nothing to commit' on stdout; test assertions check only stderr and fail to diagnose the actual problem.
The per-store advisory lock in _with_index_lock_retry protects each individual run_git_write call but not the add/commit pair; concurrent interleaving is legal and occurs under load.
Test must commit each writer's own pathspec instead of bare whole-index commits to ensure both writers always have their own changes to commit regardless of interleaving.
Test assertions must report command identity, both stdout and stderr, and actual rc values to enable self-diagnosis of future failures instead of bare AssertionError.
